PROP-e5782b58-asm-001.text: RLS policies must enforce that non-admin users cannot read other users' member records.
PROP-e5782b58-asm-001.assertion: forall SELECT on members.users by user u: u.is_admin == false => row.id == u.id

locations.note: User-context queries use anon key (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) via createClient(). RLS applies to all queries through this client. Schema is 'member'.
Admin client uses SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY and bypasses RLS. Only used for admin server actions.
